newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Randgold says West Rand merger Sept 15.
newsitem.headline: Randgold says West Rand merger Sept 15.

text.p: Randgold and Exploration Co Ltd said on Thursday that the operative date for the proposed merger of its three West Rand mines -- Buffelsfontein, Blyvooruitzicht and Durban Roodepoort Deep -- was scheduled for September 15.
Randgold said in a statement that the scheme meetings and general meetings will be held on August 28.

The merger will be implemented by schemes of arrangement which will result in Buffels and Blyvoor becoming wholly-owned subsidiaries of Durban Deep, subject to the usual approvals, and being delisted on September 12.
Buffels shareholders will be entitled to 110 Durban Deep ordinary shares per 100 shares held and Blyvoor shareholders to 25 per 100, the company said earlier this month.
The original ratios were 77 per 100 in the case of Buffels and 20 in the case of Blyvoor. The original ratios were revised earlier this month due to the downturn in the gold price.
The bullion price hit a 12-year low of around $314 an ounce earlier this month. It was last trading at $325.70/326.20.
The terms for the Blyvoor options remain unchanged at 20 new Durban Deep options per 100.
